about: The camera's framing hints (IMP-022; player/player.gd): each a box in the town grid (its centre x, y and design altitude, its size along x, y and up) where the third-person camera swings most of the way to a side-on `view` (a compass bearing to look along) and its arm to `arm` metres, while the keys still move the walker as the mouse turned it. H in play turns the framing off and on.

hints.note: Dechen-tsang's guest yard, the west range's gallery before the Tibetan room (kit/trading.py: GAL 1.3 m, from y 3.3 to 17.0 of the house): seen from the yard, side on (Greg's 1779)

the plank-and-rope bridge over the Sky Stair, its middle half (assets/generated/terrain/bridges.json BR-01: 22 m from H-SHL-080's roof to H-SHL-061's at bearing 97, its deck about 2,751 m, sagging 0.74 m): seen side on looking down the stair, the drop and the pilgrims below in the frame (IMP-027)
